summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K reporting the signing of a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with PEMEX to explore strategic and technical cooperation in the hydrocarbons industry, including E&P, refining, and lower-carbon initiatives. The MoU is valid for two years, creates no binding investment commitment, partnership, or joint venture, and any future opportunities would require separate agreements, approvals, and governance. This is a routine disclosure of a preliminary cooperation framework, not a special situation.
